newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus postpones new share listing.
newsitem.headline: Optimus postpones new share listing.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA has put off the listing of 1,104,573 shares exchanged for 159 of its convertible bonds until after the firm's shareholders' meeting due on May 22, Optimus said.
The firm had previously applied to the Warsaw bourse for the shares to be listed on April 4.

The firm said it was withdrawing its share listing application in anticipation of the bourse's and the National Securities Depository's (KDPW) opinion on the timing of the dividend attached to the shares and those already listed.
The firm said that after the meeting it would apply for the shares converted from the bonds to be listed.
